Name: HxW Decorative Plants Furniture Set
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[size=5] [center]
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/0eLxH9U.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[/size]
[size=5]This is for the plants moms, the plant dads, the plant platonic partners, the plant besties....[/size]

H&W Decorative Plants Pack has 97 (WOW) new little potted plants and hanging planters for you to decorate with! They all rotate so you can flip them depending on your needs, and you can easily change the foliage to match your recolor of choice AND choose from over 7 different flower overlays!

Pair this with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27124]H&W Plant Lovers Furniture[/url] for MAXIMUM greenery in your next playthrough. <3

[b][u]For mod makers[/u][/b] - these plants are now part of[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20139] HxW Tilesheets[/url] as well for all your map building needs!

[b][size=6]How to Configure this Mod:[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Be sure to install the mod and all dependencies[/size]
[*][size=3]Load up the game.[/size]
[*][size=3]Open Generic Mod Config Menu and Select "HxW Decorative Plants Furniture" [/size]
[*][size=3]Decide on the following:[/size]
[/list][size=3]
*Choose a color scheme for the pots - defaults to cream but can choose walnut or terracotta.
*Foliage Recolor - defaults to vanilla, but can choose Earthy, Starblue or VPR.
*Flowers - defaults to chamomile, but can choose none, blue, lily, rosebud, sunflower, pansy or violet.
[/size][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cNjfrI3.png[/img]
[/b]

[size=4]Credit first and foremost to Hime, my wonderful friend whose art never ceases to inspire me to more modding madness. You bring so much fun into my life and I love you so much hehe <3[/size][size=4]

Thanks to Max aka Skellady for providing recolor support for Cozy Chocolate Furniture!

Thanks to my wonderful friends on discord who support me and my shenanigans - I love you all so much <3[/size]
[size=4] [img]https://i.imgur.com/WrSO1e5.png[/img]

[/size]
[b][size=5]Enjoy what Hime does? Support her on [url=https://www.patreon.com/Himetarts]Patreon[/url]﻿ and follow her on [url=https://twitter.com/himetarts]Twitter[/url] for previews!

Buy Wildflour a [url=https://ko-fi.com/wildflourmods]Kofi[/url]﻿!
[/size][/b][i][size=4] [img]https://i.imgur.com/T0uVb7A.png[/img]
[/size][/i]

[size=3]This mod is for SDV 1.6 - it is not compatible with older versions of the game. [b]It is untested for mobile or multiplayer.[/b] though if all the same mods are installed, multiplayer should be fine. I cannot troubleshoot mobile; multiplayer your best bet is to try the SDV modded game support discord channel as it is often too hard for me to diagnose the issue across multiplayer saves. 

This mod is fully compatible with all other furniture mods as it has unique internal ids.
[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DhwwHA2.png[/img]

[size=4]
[b]This mod is currently in English, with more on the way we hope ![/b]

If you would like to translate this mod into another language, please reach out to me. If there is something missing from your translation version, please let me know! But also remember [u]translators are just volunteers[/u] and though I am eternally grateful for their work, they are not [u]required[/u] to do so and so there can be delays with updating translation files![/size]
